nodes.summary: There exists a compact, Hausdorff, simply connected topological space $M$ that admits an atlas of charts modelled on $\mathbb{R}^4$, such that no atlas of charts on $M$ modelled on $\mathbb{R}^4$ makes $M$ a smooth ($C^\infty$) manifold.
nodes.title: A closed simply connected topological 4-manifold with no smooth structure

nodes.summary: Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $f : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^n$ be a proper map that is a $C^\infty$ local diffeomorphism. Then $f$ is a global $C^\infty$ diffeomorphism: there is a $C^\infty$ diffeomorphism $\Phi : \mathbb{R}^n \to \mathbb{R}^n$ whose underlying map is $f$.
nodes.title: Hadamard–Caccioppoli global inverse theorem

nodes.summary: Let $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $E$ be a real inner product space of dimension $2k + 1$, with unit sphere $S = \{x \in E : \|x\| = 1\}$. If $f : S \to E$ is continuous and $\langle f(x), x \rangle = 0$ for every $x \in S$, then $f(x) = 0$ for some $x \in S$.
nodes.title: Hairy ball theorem

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 1$ and let $M$ be a Hausdorff, second-countable smooth ($C^\infty$) manifold with boundary modeled on the closed half-space $\{x \in \mathbb{R}^n : x_1 \ge 0\}$, and let $\partial M$ be its boundary. Then there is an open embedding $c : \partial M \times [0, 1) \to M$ such that $c(b, 0) = b$ for every $b \in \partial M$.
nodes.title: Collar neighborhood theorem (topological form)

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Hausdorff, second-countable smooth ($C^\infty$) manifold without boundary, modelled on a finite-dimensional real normed space, and let $e \colon M \to \mathbb{R}^n$ be a smooth embedding (a $C^\infty$ immersion that is a topological embedding) whose image $e(M)$ is closed in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Then there exist an open set $U \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ containing $e(M)$ and a $C^\infty$ map $r \colon U \to M$…
nodes.title: Smooth retraction onto a closed embedded manifold in $\mathbb{R}^n$
